evidence.title: BiSTRO — Billiards and Surfaces à la Teichmüller and Riemann, Online
evidence.summary: Simion Filip and Curtis McMullen jointly organized the BiSTRO online seminar with Carlos Matheus and Martin Möller. Filip’s CV dates the activity to April 2020–June 2021 and 2022; the seminar website names all four organizers.
